title: Is the Money Spent on Short-Form Video Social Platforms Worth It? The Role of Advertising Spillover in a Large-Scale Randomized Field Experiment on ByteDance
authors: Yitian Liang; Xinlei (Jack) Chen; Shengnan Han; Jinglong Zhang; Yubo Chen
eligible_reason: Large randomized advertising experiment on ByteDance (user-level treatment vs control). ATT/lift via exposure-adjusted (2SLS) estimators with bootstrap CIs, heterogeneity via 2SLS. Cross-sectional RCT, no DiD; data simulated.
design_notes: replication_code/main.m simulates user-level data (Z, X, W, Y), computes ATT and lift with bootstrap and 2SLS heterogeneity regressions; log.txt shows output.
data_files_note: Proprietary data not available; main.m generates simulated data.
data_provenance_note: readme: 'provides code to simulate data that shares some characteristics of a data set we worked with'.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
